annotations.title: Find rated doctors for a procedure near a place

description: Finds rated doctors for a procedure near a US city or ZIP code, for example a knee replacement surgeon near me. Returns up to 5 doctors in OpenHealth's published order: predicted result at the doctor's affiliated hospitals, then procedures a year, then distance. Each doctor has a letter grade, a yearly procedure count, a distance and a main hospital. The grade describes the hospitals, not the doctor's own skill. Only some procedures have ratings. The others return not_scored with the reason. The radius is 10, 25 or 50 miles.

place.description: A US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a 5-digit ZIP code.

procedure.description: The procedure, as an id such as knee-replacement or in plain words such as knee replacement.

radius_miles.description: The search radius in miles: 10, 25 or 50. The default is 25.

name: find_doctors_for_procedure
title: Find rated doctors for a procedure near a place
